transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you and what brings you here today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I've just been having some trouble with my thoughts lately. I'm a designer, and... I keep getting these nagging thoughts that I’ve missed some tiny mistake in a layout, or... maybe sent the wrong version of a file to a client. 

Even when I can see it’s probably fine, my mind just... keeps circling back to it. So... I thought I should probably come in.
Do these thoughts feel intrusive or unwanted, like they’re not quite your own, and do they cause you a lot of distress even though you try not to think about them?

Um... yeah, I guess they're unwanted. Like I was saying, it's just... those same nagging thoughts about missing a tiny mistake in a layout, or the client files. 

I do try not to focus on it, but my mind just keeps circling back. It's... well, it's frustrating, I suppose.
When these thoughts come up, do you find yourself doing certain things over and over, like checking your work repeatedly, to try to ease the anxiety or make sure everything is perfect?

Um... I suppose so. Before I submit my work now, I tend to... well, I'll re-open the file. Just to compare the layers again, and re-save it. And sometimes I'll mentally walk through every design choice one more time. 

It doesn't take over my whole day or anything... it just makes me slower. And maybe a bit less free creatively, I guess.
